screen.emptyTitle: No agents on the floor yet
screen.emptyBody: Add an agent and its card lands here: what it is doing, its ticket, its context and its spend.

card.typingTip: There is unsent text on its terminal prompt. Queued messages wait until it is sent or cleared.
card.fromReply: Its latest reply in the terminal
card.fromMail: Its latest message to the floor
card.atPrompt: Waiting at a prompt in its terminal
card.contextTip: {{used}} of {{limit}} tokens in the context window
card.spendTip: What this session has spent so far, from live telemetry

ticket.hint: Writes the ticket to the board assigned to {{name}}, and tells {{name}}.
ticket.writeFailed: The ticket could not be written to the board.
ticket.writeFailedDetail: The ticket could not be written to the board: {{error}}
ticket.tellFailed: {{id}} is on the board, but {{name}} could not be told: {{error}}

crash.title: {{name}} stopped.
crash.exitedCode: Its process exited with code {{code}} at {{when}}.
crash.exitedSignal: Its process was killed (signal {{signal}}, code {{code}}) at {{when}}.
crash.workKept: Its worktree and uncommitted work are untouched.
crash.restartTip: Start its engine again in the same folder. This engine cannot continue the old conversation.
crash.restartContinueTip: Start its engine again and pick the conversation up where it stopped.
crash.logFailed: The crash log could not be opened.

restart.noTerminal: This agent has no terminal to restart.
restart.crossEngine: A conversation cannot continue on a different engine.
restart.noTranscript: The session's transcript was not found.
restart.killFailed: The current process could not be stopped.
restart.resumeRefused: The engine refused to continue the session.

room.ideTip: Open this agent's folder in the IDE
room.focusTip: Put the keyboard in its terminal
room.splitAria: Drag to resize the conversation and the terminal. Double-click to reset.
room.readFailed: The conversation could not be read just now. Showing what was there before.
room.noTranscriptEngine: {{name}}'s engine keeps no transcript this app can read, so its replies are in the terminal only. Its messages and your sends still show here.
room.noTranscriptYet: {{name}} has not started a session yet; its replies show here once it does.
room.emptyBody: Send {{name}} a message, or steer its next turn. Its replies, its messages to the floor and its questions for you appear here.
room.typedTip: You typed this into its terminal
room.floorTip: Typed into its terminal through the queue: a send from Classic, the orchestrator, a schedule or Slack
room.noTerminalBody: {{name}} has no live terminal on this floor.
room.inFocusMode: The terminal is in focus mode

wheel.pauseTip: Refuse its next tool calls until you resume. It keeps its session and can still answer.
wheel.haltTip: Let the current step finish, then stop cleanly. The session is kept.
wheel.holdOnTip: Take {{name}} aside: {{god}} sends it nothing until you end the 1:1. It keeps running and answering you.
wheel.holdOffTip: End the 1:1. {{god}} can hand {{name}} work again.
wheel.deliveriesPausedTip: The floor's deliveries are paused. Queued messages wait; Send next in the queue releases one.
wheel.noHooks: Its engine may not honour this; Claude Code does.

composer.placeholder: Message {{name}}. Send queues it, Steer lands on the next turn.
composer.hint: Send waits until {{name}} is free. Drop files or paste a screenshot to attach.
composer.hintVoice: Send waits until {{name}} is free. Hold ⌥ to speak; drop files or paste a screenshot to attach.
composer.voiceNoKey: Add a Groq key in Settings to dictate
composer.recording: Listening… click the mic again to stop.
composer.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.
composer.heldDraft: held: there is unsent text on {{name}}'s prompt
composer.heldPaused: held: the floor's deliveries are paused

settings.title: {{name}} settings
settings.sameEngineNote: Applying restarts {{name}} on the new model and continues the conversation.
settings.newEngineNote: Applying restarts {{name}} on the new engine with a fresh session.
settings.busyWarning: {{name}} is in the middle of a turn; restarting interrupts it.
settings.appliedContinued: {{name}} restarted and is continuing the conversation.
settings.roleHint: Saved when you leave the field. The orchestrator reads it when routing work.
settings.roleFailed: The role could not be saved in the hive.
settings.capHint: Work tokens (input, output and cache writes) before the breaker stops it. Empty for no cap.
settings.capInvalid: Enter a whole number of tokens, or leave it empty.
